sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fire Release, Lightning Release

system.description:
You mold starlight, into a cage, before slamming it down over your target, forcing them to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they are captured within this cage. The cage, is large enough to enclose a single 5 by 5-foot space, capturing a medium sized creature. This cage has 20 hit points and an AC of 15, but does not intercept damage for the capture creatures. If the captured creature attempts to leave the space as a result of movement, or make a melee attack against the cage they take 5d6 fire damage and must make a Constitution saving throw being Burned on a failure.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the cages hit points by +8 and the damage it deals by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the size of the cage to a 15-foot cube, and force all creatures in the cages area to make the Dexterity saving throw. If this jutsu is cast at S rank, increase the size of the cage to a 25-foot cube.
